text:
Maya: heads-up — we need a design for org-scoped perf dashboards that tie token-level latency to kernel selection + KV cache hits. customer asked for per-workspace KPIs and RBAC filtered views today.
Igor: +1. do we want per-route breakdowns (embedding vs chat vs generate) or start with top-3 customer routes?
Maya: start with top-3 routes per tenant (generate/chat/embeddings). keep token-latency breakdown: total, kernel-exec, kv-lookup, batching-wait, network. Want to be able to filter by model variant and quantization profile.
Li: curious about KV partitioning impact — a customer reported tail latency spikes when their workspace had high eviction churn. we should include kv-hit-rate, avg-ttl, and eviction-rate in the dashboard.
Sam: for instrumentation we need stable labels: org_id, workspace_id, route, model_variant, kernel_tag, quant_profile, instance_type. also add batch_size and queue_wait_ms as fields on traces.
Maya: agreed. also add a "kernel_selector" tag that records chosen kernel version + heuristic (e.g., "auto_v2:seq128-opt").
Igor: implementation note — current token-latency metric is per-request aggregated. we need to break it into per-token histograms to surface hot tokens. that will increase cardinality. how do we want to store?
Li: maybe store per-token percentiles (p50/p95/p99) with sliding window per-org. full histogram for only sampled traces. we can trade off cardinality with sampling and pre-aggregation.
Ash: for RBAC: product wants org-admins to see only their workspaces, platform-admins to see all, and SRE to see anonymized cross-tenant aggregates. We need enforcement at the query layer, not just dashboards.
Maya: yes — query-layer enforcement. propose a metrics-gateway that rewrites queries to inject org_id filters and respects role claims from the console session token.
Sam: ops-bot: perf-regression alerts should fire when a route's p95 token-latency increases >20% vs baseline AND kv_hit_rate drops >10% in the last 30m. ops-bot please log that.
ops-bot: noted. created check: perf_regression_org_route_kernel_kv. threshold: p95_token_latency > 1.2*baseline AND kv_hit_rate < 0.9*baseline over 30m. alert -> #incidents + paging.
Igor: on kernel selection: we should record time-to-kernel (scheduling/compilation) and execution time separately. some regressions look like kernel compile thrash on low-traffic models.
Li: profiling results from last week show kernel switch churn correlates with batch-size variance. attaching snippet of the sampled trace format:
```
trace_id: 0xabc123
org_id: 42
route: generate
model_variant: t5x-quant8
kernel_tag: seq128_opt_v3
batch_size: 8
queue_wait_ms: 34
kv_lookup_ms: 4
kernel_compile_ms: 0
kernel_exec_ms: 78
kv_hit: true
```
Sam: nice. for dashboards let's expose a small set of precomputed KPIs per-org: tokens/s, p95_token_latency, kv_hit_rate, avg_batch_size, kernel_switch_rate, cost_per_token_est. plus links to sampled traces for deep-dive.
Maya: UX ask — per-workspace default rollup should be 1h window with ability to zoom to 1m for hotspots. make timezone aware.
Ash: security note — logs that include org_id must be access-controlled. consider hashing workspace_id in cross-tenant aggregates.
Igor: action items: 1) instrumentation PR to add kernel_selector tag + per-token histogram hooks (assigned @Igor) 2) metrics-gateway prototype for RBAC query rewrite (assigned @Maya) 3) dashboard mockups with per-route KPIs + sampling links (assigned @Li) 4) alert rule for combined token-latency + kv regression (assigned @Sam).
Maya: timeline? want prototype in staging by next Tue so customer preview at end of week.
Li: I'll mock dashboards by Fri.
Sam: I'll land the alert rule as a draft today.
Igor: starting the instrumentation branch now, will post draft PR in ~4h.
Maya: thanks team — ping me if any blockers. :thumbsup:
